reviews.comment: In class attendance/questions: these really helped with the exams, and he explains each question really well. No homework outside of class except for group projects. He is a sweet professor who cares about our success and learning. The exams were all workout problems, but they weren't very hard if you went over the in class examples.
Poorly Organized, Syllabus seem to be written by a 12-year-old

Mostly graded by 3 tests and a group project. Is generous with partial credit on tests and as long as you study, you should be fine. Group project can be tedious but get ahead of it. Attendance is mandatory as there is iClicker questions in class for a grade. Nice guy and overall the class isn't too bad. Hands out lots of paper so bring a folder.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things
